definitions.gloss: lack of sleep; sleep deprivation; not getting enough sleep
definitions.explanation: The state of having slept less than needed, often resulting in tiredness.

examples.japanese: {寝不足|ねぶそく}で{頭|あたま}がぼーっとする。
examples.english: My head is foggy from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}{寝不足|ねぶそく}が{続|つづ}いている。
{寝不足|ねぶそく}は{健康|けんこう}に{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: Lack of sleep is not good for your health.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{寝|ね} (sleep) + {不足|ふそく} (insufficiency, shortage)

RELATED SLEEP VOCABULARY:
・{夜更|よふ}かし - staying up late
・{二度寝|にどね} - going back to sleep
・{睡眠不足|すいみんぶそく} - sleep deprivation (more formal)
・{寝坊|ねぼう} - oversleeping

COLLOCATIONS:
・{寝不足|ねぶそく}で〜 - due to lack of sleep
・{寝不足|ねぶそく}が{続|つづ}く - lack of sleep continues
・{寝不足|ねぶそく}を{解消|かいしょう}する - to catch up on sleep
